question: What fields does VolumeMount define to control how a Volume is attached inside a Container?

ground_truth.answer: VolumeMount connects a named Volume (declared in PodSpec.volumes) into a Container. Required: name must match a Volume.name in the same Pod; mountPath is the absolute path inside the container. Optional: readOnly (boolean, default false); subPath mounts a specific subdirectory of the volume instead of its root; subPathExpr is like subPath but supports $(ENV_VAR) expansion via the downward API; mountPropagation controls mount propagation: None (default, no propagation), HostToContainer (host mounts become visible inside the container), Bidirectional (container mounts also propagate to the host).
context: io.k8s.api.core.v1.VolumeMount: mounts a named Volume into a Container; name and mountPath are required; readOnly, subPath, subPathExpr, and mountPropagation are optional
